CREDIT: Shane (Voronoi Geode / Perspex Web Lattice) - recoloured for eclipse-os
TITLE: Eclipse Voronoi

CONTROLS.NAME: rig_color
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: The crystals. FIRST colour control in this list, so it is /controls/global/color/1 and /controls/scene/rigcolor - the same address every eclipse scene answers to. Defaults to red, which is where the original sits, so the scene looks like itself before a sender is driving it.

CONTROLS.NAME: rig_color_2
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: The rim light and the environment reflection. SECOND colour control, so /controls/global/color/2 and /controls/scene/rigcolor2. Defaults to the original's cool blue rim. Read only with auto_second off.

CONTROLS.NAME: auto_second
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Derive the second colour as the complement of rig_color instead of reading rig_color_2. On by default, because the sender is one fixture.

CONTROLS.NAME: manual_color
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: A first colour to try by hand while the link is live, which otherwise overwrites rig_color thirty times a second. Read only with color_by_hand on.

CONTROLS.NAME: rig_amount
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: How much of the picture the rig paints. 0 is Shane's original fiery palette untouched; 1 is the rig's colour throughout. Everything between is a cross-fade.

CONTROLS.NAME: texture_color
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: How much of the agate photograph's own hue survives. 0 keeps its marbling as luminance only and lets the rig own the colour; 1 is the original's yellow-olive stone. The detail is the same either way - this is hue, not detail.

CONTROLS.NAME: media_texture
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Use the loaded media as the crystal texture in place of the agate. OFF by default, unlike the original, so that a cue which names no media cannot inherit the last cue's clip into the stone - and so that black.mp4, which is how this show says 'no media', does not turn the crystals black.

CONTROLS.NAME: pulse
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Causes a bright pulse to emanate from the center.

CONTROLS.NAME: speed_motion
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Affects the speed of the crystal gyration.

CONTROLS.NAME: grid_growth
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Let the music open the cells out. On, the Voronoi seeds are pulled back to a regular grid as syn_Presence falls, so a quiet passage tightens to a lattice and a full one scatters into crystals. Off, the cells stay scattered whatever the music does.

CONTROLS.NAME: highs_shimmer
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Modulate the surface noise with syn_HighHits, so the stone glitters on the hi-hats. Off, the noise is steady.

CONTROLS.NAME: elevation
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Zooms the camera in or out. Fully out causes it to take on a 'planetoid' look.

CONTROLS.NAME: spinning
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Whether or not the camera is rotating.

CONTROLS.NAME: alternate_crystals
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: OFF: Standard, angular crystals. ON: Grid-like crystals using the manhattan distance.

CONTROLS.NAME: rot_distort
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Deforms the surface, distorting the edges in glitchy ways.

CONTROLS.NAME: alternate_stone
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Which of the two agate photographs the crystals are cut from. OFF is the original's red geode stone, ON its circuit-like one. With texture_color at 0 this is a choice of marbling, not of colour - the original's red_geode and green_circuits toggles were a choice of both.
